channel.title: Journeys In Japan
channel.desc: The San'in Kaigan Geopark Trail is a 230-kilometer-long course connecting the Sea of Japan coastline along Tottori, Hyogo, and Kyoto prefectures, which were designated as a UNESCO Global Geopark. Canadian actor Kyle Card dives into the dynamic landscapes?veritable museums of topography and geology where traces of Earth from 30 million years ago remain?and the way of life in old fishing villages.
